channel.title: Paksh: Crime & Law
channel.description: Paksh maps how India's media covers every story — coverage, gaps, and how it develops, in English and Hindi.

item.title: Garry Kasparov warned of danger to his life by FBI
item.description: Former world chess champion Garry Kasparov stated that the FBI had warned him of a danger to his life. Kasparov, a Russian dissident, said that he and his family "will not truly be safe as long as Putin is in power." Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Former Priest Convicted of Rape and Sexual Assault
item.description: A former priest has been found guilty of rape and sexual assault. The victim stated 'Shame on Church of England' following the verdict. The priest was also reported to have run a 'cult' group inspired by rave culture. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Man Fatally Shot at London Memorial Service, Police Launch Manhunt
item.description: A 40-year-old man was fatally shot in front of approximately 50 people, including children, during a memorial service in west London. Police described the incident as a 'senseless act of violence' and have launched a manhunt for the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Egypt Arrests Matsadaash Newsroom Staff
item.description: Egyptian authorities have arrested the entire editorial team of Matsadaash, described as one of the country's few independent media outlets. The arrests are part of a significant crackdown on independent media in Egypt. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Apple to Enhance Mac Data Controls for AI Requests
item.description: Apple announced it will implement new measures to flag artificial intelligence requests for Mac data. This decision follows complaints regarding Meta's AI model, Muse, and aims to provide greater control over data access by AI agents on… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Texts Reveal Trump Assassin Suspect Discussed 3D Printer Parts
item.description: Texts exchanged by Thomas Crooks, the suspect in an assassination attempt on Donald Trump, reportedly discussed "3D print the parts" in the lead-up to the shooting in Butler, Pennsylvania. The messages were revealed following the incident. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Fire, Smoke Seen Near Riyadh Aramco Facility Amid Saudi-Houthi Escalation
item.description: A large plume of smoke and fire was observed near an Aramco facility south of Riyadh on Saturday, according to a witness cited by Reuters. This incident occurred amidst escalating hostilities between Saudi Arabia and Yemen's Iran-aligned… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: Kerala HC directs Speaker on MLA Kappan's disqualification plea
item.description: The Kerala High Court has directed the Assembly Speaker to take steps to decide on a plea seeking the disqualification of Pala MLA Mani C Kappan. The court's order follows a petition filed with the Speaker. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: IIT Bombay Professor Questioned in Student Suicide Case
item.description: Mumbai Police questioned IIT Bombay Professor Doolla for 10 hours in connection with a student suicide case. The professor stated that he followed guidelines and did not use casteist words. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Five Indian-origin individuals arrested in Canada on extortion charges
item.description: Five individuals of Indian origin have been arrested in Canada in connection with cases involving extortion, arson, and drugs. The arrests are linked to a significant extortion racket targeting Indian businessmen in Canada. One report… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Two killed in West Bengal mob lynching over cattle theft suspicion
item.description: Two people were killed and another injured in a mob lynching incident in West Bengal, reportedly over suspicion of cattle theft. The incident occurred in North Bengal. Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Disciple of Premanand Maharaj Dies, Another Goes Missing
item.description: Following the death of Rasik Dulari Sharan, a disciple of Premanand Maharaj, another disciple has been reported missing. A 33-second CCTV footage from before Rasik Dulari Sharan's death has raised new questions. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Two Assam Women Missing After Being Sent to Bangladesh; MP Seeks External Affairs Minister's Help
item.description: Two women from Assam have gone missing after being sent to Bangladesh. Congress MP Gaurav Gogoi has written to External Affairs Minister S. Jaishankar seeking his intervention to locate them. The women are reported to have been "illegally… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 1 · Right 0.

item.title: Elderly Couple Hit by SUV in Delhi; Driver Arrested
item.description: An elderly couple was struck by an SUV in Kirti Nagar, Delhi. The driver of the SUV has been arrested. CCTV footage reportedly shows the couple being flung into the air after the vehicle collided with them outside a temple. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Tennessee Prison Chief Resigns After Botched Christa Pike Execution
item.description: Frank Strada, the head of Tennessee's prison system, will resign following the failed execution of Christa Pike. Pike is in critical condition after surviving two lethal injections. Governor Bill Lee announced Strada's departure and stated… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 1.

item.title: Bengal Government to Probe Mamata Banerjee's 2021 Leg Injury
item.description: The West Bengal government has announced a fresh probe into the leg and waist injuries sustained by Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee during her 2021 election campaign. The injury occurred in 2021, and one report notes that Suvendu Adhikari… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Envoy: India Cannot Give Deadline on Sheikh Hasina Extradition
item.description: India cannot provide a deadline for the extradition of Sheikh Hasina to Bangladesh, according to Indian envoy Dinesh Trivedi. Hasina, 79, has been residing in India after fleeing Dhaka. Trivedi stated that "nobody can give a time frame"… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 2 · Right 1.

item.title: India Summons Pakistan Envoy Over Border Incident, Rejects Claims
item.description: India summoned the Chargé d’Affaires of the Pakistan High Commission on Saturday to protest alleged continued facilitation of illegal cross-border infiltration from Pakistan. The Ministry of External Affairs (MEA) rejected Pakistan's… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 7 · Right 2.

item.title: LGBTQ+ Influencer Mad Sandhu Shot Dead in Amritsar
item.description: Social media influencer and makeup artist Mad Sandhu was shot dead by motorcycle-borne assailants in Amritsar, Punjab. Police have registered an FIR and launched a probe into the incident. Sandhu, who identified as LGBTQ+, had a… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 9 · Right 1.

item.title: IAF Chief Flags Fighter Jet Delays, Calls for Faster Deliveries
item.description: Air Chief Marshal A.P. Singh stated that delays in fighter jet deliveries are "going to hurt us" and are impacting the Indian Air Force's (IAF) strength, which has fallen to 29 squadrons. He emphasized the need for the IAF to induct 36-40… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 4.

item.title: Woman Allegedly Assaulted, Stripped at Guwahati Nightclub; Manager, Others Arrested
item.description: A woman was allegedly assaulted and stripped by bouncers at a nightclub in Guwahati. A video of the incident has emerged. Police have filed a suo motu case and arrested seven people, including the club manager. The club was reportedly open… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 3.

item.title: Gypsy Rose Blanchard's Partner Ken Urker Found Dead
item.description: Ken Urker, the partner of Gypsy Rose Blanchard, was found dead inside his home in Raceland, Louisiana. Deputies responded to the residence after Urker did not respond to a birthday text message and was found "dead upon arrival," according… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: Car crashes into crowd in Australia, injuring 10
item.description: A car crashed into a crowd of rugby fans north of Sydney, Australia, injuring 10 people. Two individuals were reported to be in critical condition: a five-year-old girl and a 67-year-old man. The incident occurred near Newcastle, involving… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 10 · Right 0.

item.title: US inmate critical after botched lethal injection execution
item.description: A female inmate in Tennessee is in critical condition following a lethal injection execution that was reportedly botched. The state has initiated a review of its lethal injection process in light of the incident. Details regarding the… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 6 · Right 0.

item.title: Lawyers Body Forms Inquiry Commission on Election Commission's Special Intensive Review
item.description: A lawyers' body has formed a five-judge inquiry commission to investigate the Election Commission of India's Special Intensive Review (SIR). The commission is scheduled to submit its report by December. The Lawyers Association for… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 0 · Right 2.

item.title: Cyber fraud cases reported across India
item.description: Multiple reports detail cyber fraud incidents across India. In one case, a judicial institution employee's account was hacked, leading to a loss of ₹99,000, and police have registered a case. Separately, in Bhind, eight individuals… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Singapore Seizes Luxury Condos in Money-Laundering Case, Buyers Scarce
item.description: Singaporean authorities have seized luxury condominiums as part of the city-state's largest money-laundering case. Despite the seizures, the properties are struggling to attract buyers, with one potential buyer expressing a desire to "just… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Parliamentary panel may recommend action on crypto monitoring
item.description: A parliamentary panel is considering recommending government action regarding the monitoring of cryptocurrencies. The panel's potential recommendations are focused on how to oversee the digital currency landscape. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Indian Pilot Smit Machchhar Recovers After Mid-Air Stabbing
item.description: Captain Smit Machchhar, an Indian pilot for flydubai, is recovering well after a mid-air stabbing attack on an Israel-bound flight. The incident, which occurred on flight FZ1073, involved an attack from within the cockpit. Machchhar's… Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 4 · Right 0.

item.title: FSSAI finds Nestle dairy whitener unsafe, orders halt to sales
item.description: The Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI) has declared a sample of Nestle's low-fat dairy whitener, collected at Hotel Lalit, as "unsafe." Following this finding, FSSAI has ordered an immediate halt to the sales of the… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 1 · Right 2.

item.title: Boiler explosion at Andhra Pradesh pharma factory kills workers
item.description: A boiler explosion occurred at a pharmaceutical factory in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, resulting in the deaths of at least four workers and injuring more than ten others. Reports indicate that five employees died and over ten were injured in… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Ethiopia's Tigray Region Faces Internet, Phone Disruptions Amid Renewed Fighting
item.description: Internet and phone networks have been disrupted in Ethiopia's war-hit Tigray region following renewed fighting. The civil war in Tigray had previously led to the region being completely cut off from the outside world. Ethiopia's military… Coverage: Left 3 · Centre 7 · Right 1.

item.title: NY Governor Vows to Close 'Intoxication Loophole' After Cornell Assault
item.description: New York Governor Kathy Hochul has pledged to close an "intoxication loophole" in state law following an assault case at Cornell University. The case has brought renewed scrutiny to a little-known New York law concerning intoxicated… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 1.

item.title: Chad Lowe's daughter Fiona's cause of death confirmed
item.description: The cause of death for 13-year-old Fiona, daughter of actor Chad Lowe, has been confirmed by the L.A. County coroner. Chad Lowe's father has spoken about his granddaughter Fiona's death at age 13. Coverage: Left 2 · Centre 2 · Right 0.

item.title: Judge Blocks Border Wall Construction in Texas National Park
item.description: A federal judge has temporarily blocked the Trump administration from restarting border wall construction in the Big Bend region of Texas. The order specifically halts work in a national park. Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 0.

item.title: Hindu Temple in Ohio Attacked with Bricks While Devotees Were Inside
item.description: A Hindu temple in the Greater Cleveland area of Ohio was attacked with bricks on Friday afternoon, shattering its windows while priests and devotees were inside. The Shree Swaminarayan Hindu Temple Vadtaldham was targeted during daylight… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 3 · Right 5.

item.title: Five Indian Seafarers Rescued After Tanker Hit by Projectile
item.description: Five Indian nationals were rescued after the Kuwait-flagged tanker MT Kazimah III was struck by a projectile in the Strait of Hormuz. The Indian Embassy in Oman coordinated the rescue of the seafarers, who were brought ashore safely in… Coverage: Left 1 · Centre 3 · Right 3.

item.title: AI Firm Anthropic Faces Scrutiny Over Risks and Funding
item.description: Artificial intelligence company Anthropic is reportedly facing investigations by the U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) concerning potential risks to consumers. Concurrently, Anthropic is seeking a valuation exceeding $2 trillion and has… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 8 · Right 0.

item.title: Gurugram Man Dies After Fall From Noida High-Rise; Police Investigate Financial Distress
item.description: A man from Gurugram died after falling from the 43rd floor of a high-rise building in Noida. Police are investigating the incident, with a focus on the possibility of financial distress as a motive. The man had reportedly checked into an… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 2 · Right 3.

item.title: Bitchat App Removed from India's Apple App Store
item.description: The Bitchat application has been removed from the Apple App Store in India following an order from the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY). Apple cited the MeitY order as the reason for the app's disappearance… Coverage: Left 0 · Centre 4 · Right 2.
